mkdir -p ~/omni-gm-scripts && cat > ~/omni-gm-scripts/vtt2omni.py <<'EOF'
import re, sys, os
src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
if os.path.exists(dst):
    sys.exit(f"refusing to overwrite {dst}")
cue = re.compile(r'(\d+):(\d\d):(\d\d)\.(\d+)\s+-->\s+(\d+):(\d\d):(\d\d)\.(\d+)')
def secs(h,m,s,f): return int(h)*3600+int(m)*60+int(s)+float('0.'+f)
segs=[]; cur=None
for line in open(src, encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines():
    m = cue.search(line)
    if m:
        g=m.groups(); cur=[secs(*g[:4]), secs(*g[4:]), None, []]; segs.append(cur); continue
    if cur is None or not line.strip(): continue
    v = re.match(r'<v\s+([^>]+)>(.*)', line)
    if v:
        cur[2]=v.group(1).strip(); text=v.group(2)
    else:
        text=line
    text=re.sub(r'</?[^>]+>','',text).strip()
    if text: cur[3].append(text)
merged=[]
for st,en,spk,txt in segs:
    spk=(spk or 'Table').replace(':','')
    t=' '.join(txt)
    if not t: continue
    if merged and merged[-1][2]==spk and st-merged[-1][1]<2 and en-merged[-1][0]<30:
        merged[-1][1]=en; merged[-1][3]+=' '+t
    else:
        merged.append([st,en,spk,t])
merged.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
with open(dst,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for st,en,spk,t in merged:
        s=int(st); f.write(f"[{s//3600:02d}:{s%3600//60:02d}:{s%60:02d}] {spk}: {t}\n")
EOF
cat > ~/omni-gm-scripts/check.py <<'EOF'
import re, sys, collections, os
p=sys.argv[1]; lines=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines()
pat=re.compile(r'^\[(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d)\] ([^:]+): (.+)$'); prev=-1; c=collections.Counter()
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    m=pat.match(l); assert m, f"bad line {i}"
    t=int(m[1])*3600+int(m[2])*60+int(m[3]); assert t>=prev, f"time decreases at {i}"; prev=t
    assert len(l.encode())<30000; c[m[4]]+=1
assert os.path.getsize(p)<8_000_000 and len(lines)<=20000
print("OK", len(lines), "lines", dict(c)); print("\n".join(lines[:3]))
EOF
cd <gm-machine> && python3 -I ~/omni-gm-scripts/vtt2omni.py session-3.vtt session-3.omni-gm.txt && python3 -I ~/omni-gm-scripts/check.py session-3.omni-gm.txt
